summary: Frontend testing complete for Scope 2 fixes: (1) Region priority fuel filtering works - Electricity (India) shown for India facility, (2) Scope 2 Purchased Electricity calculation works (1000 × 0.71 = 710 tCO2), (3) Custom emission factor form with mandatory justification works correctly.

feature_1_region_priority_fuel_filtering.test_scenario: Selected facility test-1 with country='India', selected Scope 2, category='Purchased Electricity'
feature_1_region_priority_fuel_filtering.expected: Show Electricity (India) fuel instead of Global when facility country matches

feature_1_region_priority_fuel_filtering.evidence: Screenshot shows fuel dropdown with 'Electricity (India)' option. Region: India displayed in Selected Fuel Parameters.
